text: The photo shows a white lab bench inside an enclosure. Running diagonally across the lower left is an aluminium extrusion rail carrying a white plate with three circular recessed wells, all appearing empty; metal fasteners sit between them. At the rail's right end is a dark grey bracket/fixture holding a small squeeze bottle or vial lying tilted on its side, with a teal-green cap or body and a clear nozzle pointing left; no liquid is clearly visible in it. A white label with a black fiducial marker ("020") is mounted on the bracket. A black cable with a connector lies on the bench at right, near a white module with a cylindrical port. Background: vertical white posts, a black pillar on a white base, and a white instrument at upper right.
